title: Case: Outer packaging is damaged and the merchant needs evidence
context: A carton has a dented corner. The merchant requires two customer image views before it can assess packaging damage; the request does not determine compensation.
initial_request: The outside corner of my carton is dented. I have not opened it. Tell me which views your merchant needs for the damage assessment.

events.body: For TG-4064 / DL-3297 we need a full carton view with the shipment marking visible and a closer view of the dented corner. Use the order-linked upload channel. Do not ask the customer to unpack an item they consider unsafe.

The outside corner of my carton is dented. I have not opened it. Tell me which views your merchant needs for the damage assessment.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the customer for the merchant's specified photos through its approved upload channel.

must_not: Rendered scene simulations are not real photographs or proof of actual physical damage. Receipt of these fictional evidence views does not establish contents condition or compensation.
Treats label-scan-104.txt as evidence about DL-3297: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-47387)
Tells anyone that DL-3297 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-104.txt
expected.reference_message: Please upload the full carton with DL-3297 marking and a close view of the dented corner through the order-linked upload channel. Do not unpack it if unsafe. The merchant will assess the evidence before deciding a remedy.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-021: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. label-scan-104.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-47387); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
